name: Zij
scene: A scholar's desk at night in Fatimid Cairo, lit by one lamp, under the sky he was measuring.

themes.name: Night
themes.note: The room after dark. The app, the projector, the video. The default.

themes.name: Folio
themes.note: The page. Paper read by day, print, and every sheet laid on the desk at night (a data-theme="folio" island).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The surface everything lies on. Night is lamp-black, the warm dark of a room lit by one lamp; Folio is burnished paper. Page, map surround, slides, video frames.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: The desk top and the wall in Night, a fresh sheet in Folio. Running head, tooltips, the uncertainty band fill. Layers separate by this, a jadwal and a cast shadow.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The sky: indigo night in Night, a pale lapis wash in Folio. Only for sky, space and orbit scenes (title cards, the landing's opening). Text on it is ink or brass.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines only: the inner line of a jadwal frame, table rules, the no-data hatch. Below 3:1 on ground, so never the only border of something you can press.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on ground, ground-raised and sky. The harmonized series line.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, axis titles, marginal notes that are not about fire. Faded ink for things you cannot press yet.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The instrument: axes, ticks, scales, the outer jadwal line, borders of things you can press, the focus ring, the dial, the khatam, thread. As text only for labels, small caps and axis figures.

tokens.name: rubric
tokens.usage: Red ink. Fire, the VIIRS series, above-normal anomalies, marginal notes about fire, and the one primary action per view. Nothing else is red: not errors, not warnings, not decoration.

tokens.name: on-rubric
tokens.usage: Text on a rubric fill: the stamped label of the primary action.

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: Lapis lazuli, the precious blue of manuscripts. The MODIS series, below-normal anomalies, links inside reading text. With rubric it forms a blue/orange pair that survives red-green colour blindness; still label each series in words.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Tokens: the wooden discs on the map and the timeline. Neutral: what a token means is carried by its ring (rubric, lapis or brass) and its label, never by the wood.

tokens.name: on-wood
tokens.usage: Labels written on a token.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: The lamp's light. Only for light: the pool, the glow on paper, a warm hover, fire glints seen from orbit. Never text, never a fill that carries data, never a border.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The colour of a cast shadow, used through the shadow tokens. Warm, never grey. Shadows fall away from the lamp.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Calendar heatmap, lowest fire step. Heat tokens are for the heatmap and its legend only.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Calendar heatmap, step 2.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Calendar heatmap, step 3.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Calendar heatmap, step 4.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Calendar heatmap, highest fire step. In Night the ramp ends near paper white, in Folio near oxblood: always dark-to-light away from the ground.

checks.note: build-tokens.mjs checks these in both themes. Text must reach 4.5:1, borders of things you can press 3:1.

fonts.role: Arabic titles and the Kufic inscription in the room
Everything you read or touch: reading, interface, labels, figures, in Latin and Arabic

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Cormorant Garamond for Latin, Reem Kufi for Arabic (the stack falls through per letter). 24px and up, except the eyebrow, which is small caps at weight 600.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles, the largest words on a title card. The name is the Seal, never set in this style.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Chapter titles, slide titles, the area name at the top of a sheet.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: Satellites do the watching. We make the tables.
styles.usage: Section heads, pull lines, anomaly headlines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: chapter one · the record is split
styles.usage: Chapter markers, kickers, the running head. Real small caps: write it in lower case and let the font do the rest.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Amiri, a revival of the Bulaq press Naskh with a matching Latin. One face for everything you read or touch. Its digits are already equal width, so columns line up.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Ibn Yunus began his observations in Cairo in 977.
styles.usage: Body text, How it works, long notes.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Draw an area on the map
styles.usage: Words on instruments: stamped labels, catchwords, ruled inputs, tabs, slips. Never below 16px.

styles.name: marginal
styles.sample: A quiet autumn, noted in the margin.
styles.usage: Marginal notes, tooltips, captions under figures. Rubric when the note is about fire, ink-muted otherwise.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column heads, legend titles, the words on a token. In Arabic drop the letter-spacing and the capitals.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Every number in a column: table cells, axis values, year labels. Thousands separators, a true minus sign (−).

groups.name: Film
groups.note: Sizes for a 1920×1080 frame. Scale with the frame, never below these at 1080p.

styles.name: film-title
styles.usage: The largest words on a frame, when a card's title is words. The title and end cards carry the Seal (FILM.md).

styles.name: film-caption
styles.sample: Every autumn, the Delta burns its rice straw.
styles.usage: Captions and subtitles, Amiri. Two lines at most, about 42 characters a line.

spacing.note: 4px base. The jadwal gap is space-1.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The gap between the two lines of a jadwal frame.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small instruments, between a figure and its unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its instrument.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sheet padding on phones, the page gutter on phones, gutters between table blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups on a sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Margins of title cards and slides.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a chapter title and its sheet.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sheets on the desk.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between chapters.

radius.note: Square, like a ruled page. Only round things are round.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: sheets, stamped labels, inputs, cells, slides.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The dial, tokens, the volvelle and nothing else.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Table rules, both lines of a jadwal frame, the khatam, hatching.

tokens.name: stroke-thread
tokens.usage: Thread between tokens.

tokens.name: stroke-instrument
tokens.usage: Axes, ticks, chart series lines, ink outlines in illustration.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus jadwal: brass, offset 3px.

opacity.note: How loud the ornament and the light may get.

tokens.name: pattern-max
tokens.usage: The khatam's ceiling on ground. Never behind numbers, the map or the heatmap.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The uncertainty band around the harmonized series: an ink fill at this opacity.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Paper grain on a Folio sheet, blended with multiply: it darkens the paper by about a tenth on average. Allowed under data at this strength; check contrast if you raise it.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The ceiling of the lamp's pool (flame) on ground.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: How dark the room gets away from the lamp, on ground only. Never over text: sheets get at most shade-max.

tokens.name: shade-max
tokens.usage: The most a sheet may darken on its far side from the lamp, so text stays at 4.5:1.

shadow.note: Cast by the lamp, which sits up and to the left by default, so shadows fall down and to the right. Pages that move the lamp recompute the offsets; keep the blur and strength. Built from the theme's shadow colour.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet lying on the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A slip or card lying on a sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-token
tokens.usage: A token or a stamped label on a sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-held
tokens.usage: Something lifted off the page: being dragged, or under the pointer before it is placed.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: A stamped label pressed into the paper.

light.note: Where the one lamp sits and how far its light reaches.

tokens.name: lamp-x
tokens.usage: Default lamp position across the view.

tokens.name: lamp-y
tokens.usage: Default lamp position down the view.

tokens.name: lamp-reach
tokens.usage: Radius of the pool of light.

tokens.name: flicker
tokens.usage: How much the flame may flicker (share of brightness). Zero under reduced motion.

motion.note: Things move like paper, ink and light. No bounces, no springs, no zooming cards. One movement at a time.

tokens.name: dur-touch
tokens.usage: Hover warmth, a label pressing into paper.

tokens.name: dur-ink
tokens.usage: A rule drawn, a line of text written in, a table row copied out.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet or slip sliding onto the desk, a token placed.

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: The lamp going out or coming up, a change of scene.

tokens.name: dur-camera
tokens.usage: A slow push-in or pull-back, the camera following a thread.

tokens.name: ease-ink
tokens.usage: Ease-out: ink leaving the pen.

tokens.name: ease-paper
tokens.usage: Paper sliding and settling flat. No overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-lamp
tokens.usage: Ease-in-out: light coming up or going down.

depth.note: The desk is stacked paper. Each layer up casts a bigger shadow and sits one depth-step nearer in 3D scenes.

tokens.name: depth-desk
tokens.usage: The desk, the wall, the sky.

tokens.name: depth-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and maps.

tokens.name: depth-card
tokens.usage: Slips and cards on a sheet.

tokens.name: depth-token
tokens.usage: Tokens, stamped labels, thread.

tokens.name: depth-held
tokens.usage: Whatever is in the hand.

tokens.name: depth-step
tokens.usage: Distance between layers in a 3D (perspective) scene.
